name: Zhejiang Changsheng Sliding Bearings Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Changsheng Sliding Bearings Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells lubricated bearings and polymers in China and internationally. It offers self-lubricating bearings, low-friction pair components, modified engineering plastics, and fluoroplastic products. The company's products are used in automobiles, construction machinery, artificial intelligence, clean energy, and mechanical engineering industries. Zhejiang Changsheng Sliding Bearings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Jiashan, China.
